profile.headline: Software Engineer, US Army veteran
profile.summary:
I am an engineering leader, US Army veteran, father, and husband. I intentionally oscillate between management and IC roles because I believe the best way to model transformational leadership is to remain deeply technical.

Currently, I operate at the intersection of enterprise search and LLM integration. I experiment quickly, build the right tools first, and use crisp design memos to drive fast alignment. By heavily leveraging custom AI coding agents and automated eval frameworks, I can iterate rapidly on complex AI pipelines and search architectures without sacrificing quality.

Whether I’m in a leadership role or deep in the codebase as an IC, my goal is always the same: execute at a high level, solve complex architectural problems, and work with incredible teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected deterministic search workflows and LLM-native tool endpoints for Netflix's internal enterprise search and LLM chat product, surfacing structured entity data without adding inference latency.
* Developed an automated, LLM-as-judge prompt evaluation framework featuring agent-driven tuning loops to prevent regressions across multiple AI synthesis modes.
* Redesigned the search platform's authorization layer with a pluggable, chain-of-responsibility rule engine and a type-safe auditable contracts and policy checks laying the foundation to serve a growing ecosystem of LLM agents and autonomous pipelines.
* Led a enterprise search backend pilot evaluating GenAI SaaS solutions, leveraging rigorous latency, security, and quality benchmarking to define the strategic roadmap for migrating an enterprise knowledge RAG datastore and vectorizing organizational knowledge.

positions.title: Head Of Engineering
positions.description:
I headed a team of talented engineers building a new front door to healthcare.
As a leader, I helped align the team's great ideas into an achievable vision that we could execute on in a sustainable and tech-forward way.
As a manager, I prioritized the culture of our team and helped each individual grow.
As an IC, I contributed to all parts of the codebase, from wrangling event-driven architecture with workflows to building out our CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Principal Engineering Manager
positions.description: I led our NYC based teams in Commercial Software Engineering (CSE).  We work side-by-side with customers to build solutions for their biggest challenges.  We leveraged a broad range of OSS and Microsoft technologies on Microsoft Azure.  I've helped a non-profit deploy their platform to help the world's children with technologies like Azure, Kubernetes and DevOps tooling.  I also contributed to a project that enabled suppliers to manage requests from health providers for items like social distancing kits for the COVID-19 pandemic.

positions.title: Engineering Director
positions.description:
• Led multiple cross-functional problem solving teams with area focuses ranging from our Core organizer product to our enterprise offering, Meetup Pro
• Managed, mentored and coached organization of 17 engineers and 9 contractors, including developing 5 first level manager and technical leads
• Decreased analytic data latency from 4 hours to 3 seconds for new onboarding enterprise customers by developing an event driven data denormalizing solution
• Worked and communicated directly with enterprise customers and partners to help them find technical solutions leveraging Meetup’s API offerings

positions.title: Principal Engineering Lead
positions.description: • Led first fully remote contractor team.  Instilled collaborative problem solving culture to delivery automated subscription billing for Meetup’s enterprise offering.  Technologies used included Scala based microservices, Kubernetes, Google BigQuery, Google Cloud Datastore and Stripe.

positions.title: Lead of Engineering Effectiveness
positions.description:
• Led Engineering Effectiveness, an internal facing team that evangelized and championed velocity, code health and developer sanity
• Transitioned organization to Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment from a manual delivery process increasing number of monolithic deployments to production from 1.5 to >6 per day.  Implemented pipeline, refactored code base for creating artifacts, and evangelized CI/CD concepts to organization.

positions.title: Product Engineering Lead
positions.description:
• Led Meetup’s transition of subscription based revenue from CyberSource to Stripe
• Led integration of Apple In-App purchases for Meetup’s core subscription model.  Project included making our internal mock open: https://github.com/meetup/apple-of-my-iap
• Implemented and led multiple customer to customer payment solutions on the platform including Member Dues (subscription model) and Contributions (donation model) generating $30+ million dollars in revenue to Meetup organizers using Wepay

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: • Developed and operated a scalable CMS frontend in a client facing role for a GSE financial company

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Architected and implemented a distributed notification system used for brokering real-time events to GCM, Apple Push, and email services.
•	Implemented real-time updates and notifications for official Android client.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Identified issue of Customer Service’s inability to assist customers with customer website.  Proposed, designed, and developed web account administration and troubleshooting workflow solution allowing Customer Service to properly assist web-based customers.
•	Gathered requirements, and conducted training meetings for migration from database backed infrastructure to SOAP based web-services for customer website.
•	Designed, configured, and implemented networking and server details for testing environments used for customer website.  Environments included multiple preview, integration, and regression servers.
•	Identified resource waste on managing career listings for HR on corporate website.  Proposed solution that allowed HR to manage career listings.  Assisted with design and development of solution.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description: •	Conducted meetings, gathered requirements and developed employee management and scheduling system for Lighthouse Anesthesiology.

positions.title: Network Switching Systems Operator/Maintainer
positions.description:
Network Administrator/Controller
Information Management Officer
Information Assurance Security Officer

•	Administered OSPF network of more than 200 Cisco devices in the Multi-National Division-Baghdad area of operation.
•	Trained and counseled soldiers on a regular basis to handle high-tempo and high-stress situations.
